duplication_audit.novel_axis: directional cross-quantilogram dependence between fixed upper/lower quantile-hit processes of historical wave and wind paths
duplication_audit.distinction: v30 estimates conditional-bin transfer entropy I(Xpast;Ynow|Ypast) from symbolic states. v38 instead forms centered Bernoulli quantile-hit processes at fixed marginal tails and computes their normalized directional lag correlation. It contains no conditional entropy, adaptive bin, result-selected quantile, or prior-cycle prediction.

rejected_axes.conditional_cross_quantilogram: not used because fitting conditional quantiles would add a model/HPO layer

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax, and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.hit_process: upper 1{x>q}-[1-tau], lower 1{x<=q}-tau; each cross moment divided by root mean-square product with deterministic zero-denominator return 0

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Han, Linton, Oka, and Whang, The cross-quantilogram: Measuring quantile dependence and testing directional predictability between time series, Journal of Econometrics 193, 251-270 (2016)
primary_sources.use: quantile-hit directional dependence mechanism only; not performance evidence
